build_cpp_ast_from_source: use BuilderFromSource to create an AstBuilder from C++ source code and filename
generate_ast_nodes: call AstBuilder.Generate() to yield AST nodes like Class, Function, and Method from C++ source
convert_tokens_to_parameters: use TypeConverter.ToParameters() to convert a list of tokens into Parameter AST nodes
convert_tokens_to_types: use TypeConverter.ToType() to convert tokens representing base classes into Type AST nodes
print_cpp_identifiers: use PrintIndentifiers to print all identifiers from a C++ source file filtered by a predicate
